definitions.gloss: rousing oneself; mustering energy; stirring to action
definitions.explanation: summoning one's energy and determination to take action

examples.japanese: {奮起|ふんき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: I rouse myself and tackle the work.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奮起|ふんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}した→促す：10875_unagasu⟧。
examples.english: I urged the team to rouse themselves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{糧|かて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奮起|ふんき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{再挑戦|さいちょうせん}→再挑戦：17709_saichousen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to learn from my failure, rouse myself, and try again.

notes:
{奮起|ふんき} means to muster energy and motivation, often after facing difficulties or setbacks.

WRITING:
- {奮|ふん} (rouse, stir up)
- {起|き} (rise, get up)

USAGE:
- {奮起|ふんき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rouse oneself - suru verb)
- {奮起|ふんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧ (to urge someone to rouse themselves)
- Implies gathering determination after setback or challenge
- Often used in sports, work, or personal development contexts
- Positive connotation of taking action

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {奮起|ふんき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rouse oneself and do ~)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奮起|ふんき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be stirred to action by ~)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発奮|はっぷん}→発奮：07980_happun⟧ (being roused to action)
- ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧ (hard struggle)
- ⟦{奮|ふる}い{立|た}つ→奮い立つ：08252_furuitatsu⟧ (to be stirred up)
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to get motivated - casual)
